description: 180 Degrees Consulting at UCI is the world's largest university-based social impact consultancy. We provide socially conscious organizations around the world with high quality, pro bono consulting services. The branch at UCI is primarily dedicated to help socially conscious organizations in and around Orange County.

club_name: Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy at UCI
description: To promote sound managed care pharmacy principles through education and professional development of its student pharmacist members.

The Accounting Association at the University of California, Irvine is devoted to build relationships between students and professionals within the accounting business world. We achieve this by providing opportunities for students to learn about the accounting profession as well as facilitate the recruiting connections, growth and knowledge required for success in the accounting industry.

ACEing Autism at UCI is on a mission to help children with autism to grow, develop and benefit from social connections and fitness through affordable tennis programming, uniquely meeting individual needs while filling a national void for this growing and underserved population.

Active Minds at UCI mobilizes students to advocate for mental health and drivepositive change. We discuss mental health topics, promote access to campus helping services, and plan campus events. Active Minds is a national non-profit organization founded in 2001 by Alison Malmon, then a junior at the University of Pennsylvania, following the suicide of her older brother, Brian, one year earlier. Brian, also a college student, had been experiencing depression and psychosis for three years but had concealed his symptoms from everyone around him. It is a goal of Active Minds to de-stigmatize mental disorders. Active Minds is the only student organization working to utilize the student voice to change the conversation about mental health on college campuses. By developing and supporting chapters of a student-run mental health awareness, education, and advocacy group on campuses, the organization works to increase students' awareness of mental health issues, provide information and resources regarding mental health and mental illness, encourage students to seek help as soon as it is needed, and serve as liaison between students and the mental health community.

Acts College Ministry is a college fellowship that aims to love God and to love people. Acts College ministry is comprised of a network of cell groups on different campuses throughout Orange County, meeting throughout the week. A cell group is where honest friendship, Bible study, sermon discussions, constant prayer, and compassionate care are emphasized. It is within these dynamic cell groups where the core of our evangelism and discipleship take place.

Acts2Fellowship is an undergraduate Christian fellowship that welcomes students from all walks of life and backgrounds. We hope to be a place where we learn that the Bible is relevant and personal, and the claims of God are not mere stories but personal realities. We also hope to be a home-away-from-home! We meet as a group for weekly Bible studies, usually on Fridays, to learn what the Bible says about our lives. Along the way, we eat good food, have fun together, and have times to answer timeless questions while building up a sense of family in our group.

Actuarial Society at UC Irvine is a network of ambitious and motivated individuals interested in actuarial science. Our society offers numerous resources for members including internship opportunities, exam preparation workshops, and networking events with actuaries in Southern California.

ABSM @ UC Irvine is a student run initiative with a mission to empower Black students on UC Irvine’s campus by equipping them with the necessary skills to thrive in their academic & healthcare aspirations. By dismantling obstacles faced by Black students and fostering connections with diverse medical pathways, we aim to revolutionize the journey to healthcare.

club_name: Aerodynamix A Cappella (formerly Aerodynamix Acappella - AD)
description: Aerodynamix A Cappella is one of the all-gender a cappella groups formed on campus! With many talented individuals from various musical backgrounds, AD is a breath of fresh air for the a cappella genre. It is our hope that Aerodynamix A Cappella makes music that inspires, entertains and impacts.

club_name: Afghan United Association at UCI - AUA
description: AUA is a student-run organization dedicated to creating a space for individuals interested in upholding Afghan culture and ideals, creating community and tight-knit bonds amongst one another, and organizing philanthropic endeavors to help our people back home. It is a club open to anyone willing to participate regardless of their background.

AGSA shall aspire to build a community of mutual support for graduate African students at UCI. This includes promoting academic excellence, mental wellbeing, social and cultural exchange and enhancing the experiences of African students at UCI. AGSA will operate in three arms: networking, mentorship, and capacity building for students of African descent. This includes bridging the gap between academics and postgraduate career in the US for African students.

As the mission of Agape at UCI, we strive to establish an inclusive and nurturing environment for Chinese-speaking students and English-speaking students who seek to learn and understand the teachings of the Bible in Chinese at UC Irvine. Our organization is dedicated to fostering spiritual growth by providing a platform for students to deepen their understanding and practice of Christian faith, grounded in the teachings of Jesus Christ as outlined in the Holy Bible. Through a variety of activities and events, we aim to promote personal development, fellowship engagement, and meaningful connections with other students who share a common spiritual heritage.

The Ahlul-Bayt Student Association (ABSA) at UCI is a vibrant community dedicated to providing a welcoming and nurturing space for all students seeking social and spiritual guidance rooted in the profound teachings of the Ahlul-Bayt, the blessed family of the Holy Prophet (PBUH). Our primary mission is to foster a sense of belonging and unity among students of diverse backgrounds who share an interest in the spiritual wisdom, moral values, and historical legacy exemplified by the Ahlul-Bayt. ABSA UCI serves as a hub where students can explore, learn, and grow together while embracing the teachings of the Ahlul-Bayt as a source of inspiration and guidance in their academic, personal, and spiritual journeys.

Our mission is to advance the understanding and development of interpretable and aligned artificial intelligence systems. We are dedicated to addressing the long-term risks and potential harms associated with AI, as we approach the possibility of artificial general intelligence (AGI). Recognizing the profound uniqueness of human intelligence and the existential risks posed by unchecked AI advancement, we commit ourselves to ensuring that AI technologies align with human values and contribute positively to society. Learn more at https://aisafetyuci.com/

In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Alkalima aims to bring a better understanding of UC Irvine student related issues from a Muslim perspective in hopes of creating positive change on campus. Alkalima provides a forum for conscientious students to illuminate topics that are often overlooked, yet are important to both student groups and the campus community as a whole at UC Irvine. Essentially, Alkalima represents a new kind of force guided by principles of Islamic morality, justice, equality, and social responsibility that we hope to create and inspire within the context of a sometimes politically passive and socially indifferent campus environment. The kind of magazine we aim to produce is unique not only in its content, but in its vision. We strive to shift from the stereotypical, apathetic, and insular college experience, and instead move towards gaining a deeper understanding of not only community and domestic issues, but also of international topics as well. By questioning societal norms and expectations, we make it Alkalima's goal to bring back serious intellectual dialogue about the critical issues that students find important, necessary, and impactful. As Allah calls upon us in the Qur'an, "O you who believe! Stand out firmly for justice, as witnesses to Allah, even though it be against yourselves, or your parents, or your kin, be he rich or poor, Allah is a Better Protector to both (than you). So follow not the lusts (of your hearts), lest you may avoid justice, and if you distort your witness or refuse to give it, verily, Allah is Ever Well-Acquainted with what you do\" (4:135), we at Alkalima seek to embody this verse through our publication, and in our daily lives. Alkalima is published with support from Campus Progress, a division of the Center for American Progress. Online at CampusProgress.org.

Alpha Chi Omega is a national women's organization that enriches the lives of members through lifetime opportunities of friendship, leadership, learning, and service. Each member values character, personal development, academic interest, leadership, and both financial and social responsibility. As a national fraternal organization, part of our mission is to change the conversation and exceed expectations. Alpha Chi Omega demonstrates active leadership both inside and outside the greek community, and all around UC Irvine. No matter our individual course, we are women of tremendous courage and character. Alpha Chi Omega continually strives to seek the heights as we fight against domestic violence, our national philanthropy. Our work comes in many forms at both the local and national levels. We like to spread awareness, prevention and education to victims and their children.

Alpha Chi Sigma is a national professional organization dedicated to the formation of a strong community between individuals in fields in which Chemistry is a principle science. Our purpose is described by the Three Objects of the Fraternity: 1. To bind its members with a tie of true and lasting friendship. 2. To strive for the advancement of chemistry both as a science and as a profession. 3. To aid its members by every honorable means in the attainment of their ambitions as chemists throughout their mortal lives. To these ends we host professional and social events and accept new members studying in Chemically related fields to join us building a strong community here at UCI.

club_name: Alpha Epsilon Delta Pre-Health Honor Society - AED
description: Alpha Epsilon Delta is the National Health Pre-professional Honor Society dedicated to the encouragement and recognition of excellence in pre-professional health scholarship. Our Society welcomes all students engaged in the pursuit of a professional development, provides a forum for students with common interests, and extends a program of service to benefit the college/university community. If you are interested in pursuing a career in medicine, pharmacy, dentistry, optometry, physical therapy, and nursing please come talk to us.

club_name: Alpha Epsilon Omega Fraternity, Gamma Chapter
description: The goal of Alpha Epsilon Omega at the University of California in Irvine is to create an environment where bonds are made and strengthened between its members. Ultimately these bonds are to serve as powerful networking tools during and beyond our college years. Alpha Epsilon Omega promotes the Armenian history, language and culture on campus by hosting a variety of events and extending membership to men from all ethnic backgrounds. Our organization provides leadership experience by placing members in leadership positions. Alpha Epsilon Omega will support its members in reaching the highest standards of achievement in all aspects of their lives.

Alpha Epsilon Pi was founded to provide opportunities for the Jewish college man seeking the best possible college and fraternity experience. We have maintained the integrity of our purpose by strengthening our ties to the Jewish community and serving as a link between high school and career.

Alpha Eta Mu Beta is the National Biomedical Engineering Honor Society. The purpose of this organization is to recognize and promote academic excellence in the field of Biomedical Engineering, and to unify these highly qualified individuals amongst themselves and with their faculty.

Alpha Gamma Alpha was founded in 2002 by Melissa Hosboyar, Arpie Jivalagian, Alenoush Terzian, and Melineh Terzian. Through common goals, beliefs and visions for Alpha Gamma Alpha, these four young ladies were able to pull together and expand the sorority to its second campus. The Beta Chapter was founded in the Fall of 2003 at the University of California, Irvine. The Beta Chapter continues to expand its presence in the Irvine community by participating in various Greek events as well as demonstrating its continuous passion and dedication to philanthropic causes both in the Irvine community and the Armenian communities. Alpha Gamma Alpha is dedicated to fostering the interests of ambitious women, with Alumni going on to pursue careers in the fields of law, medicine, psychology and business.

club_name: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc. - AKA
description: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated (AKA) is an international service organization that was founded on the campus of Howard University in Washington, D.C. in 1908. It is the oldest Greek-lettered organization established by African-American college-educated women. Since its founding over a century ago, Alpha Kappa Alpha's mission has been to cultivate and encourage high scholastic and ethical standards, to promote unity and friendship among college women, to study and help alleviate problems concerning girls and women in order to improve their social stature, to maintain a progressive interest in college life, and to be of "Service to All Mankind." Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated Lambda Sigma chapter at the University of California, Irvine was founded on August 7th, 1977.

Alpha Kappa Delta Phi Sorority, Inc. fosters the making of successful leaders by assisting and challenging our members to reach their maximum potential. We strive to maintain the highest levels of integrity and innovation in the promotion of sisterhood, philanthropy, scholastic excellence, and Asian-Awareness in the community while creating lifelong relationships.

Alpha Kappa Psi is a co-ed professional business fraternity open to students of all majors. Based on the core principles of brotherhood, integrity, knowledge, service, and unity, we collectively strive to improve each member's personal and professional development, as well as contribute to the UCI campus and society as a whole.

Welcome to the Alpha Omega Christian Movement!We are a group of college students devoted to loving God and his people. We strive to live in obedience to the Bible and teach others about Jesus and his word. We are here to provide spiritual and relational support to any and all students as they navigate college. We have a number of fun events, Bible studies, and Bible Discussions on and off campus, all around Orange County.You can get a glimpse of us on our Instagram @alphaomegaoc or contact us for more information!

Alpha Phi International Fraternity is a membership organization dedicated to promoting sisterhood, cultivating leadership, encouraging intellectual curiosity and advocating service. Alpha Phi develops character for a lifetime. The Eta Kappa Chapter of Alpha Phi at the University of California, Irvine was founded on May 17, 1988 by a group of bright, energetic women. Today, their legacy lives on in our members. Whether you are a scholar, an athlete, or a class leader, Alpha Phi's develop strong character through our devotion to philanthropy, academics, campus leadership, and social networking.

Alpha Phi Omega is a co-ed National Service Fraternity, originally founded by Frank Reed Horton at Lafayette College in 1925. Inspired by the Boy Scouts of America, Horton felt there should be a collegiate organization that would strengthen men in the ideals of personal growth, tolerance, clean living, active leadership and support of the community. Alpha Phi Omega was born in this spirit and built upon the principles of Leadership, Friendship, and Service. Today at UC Irvine, the Rho Rho chapter of Alpha Phi Omega carries on this tradition, building friends and leaders within the UCI student body and completing over 1500 hours of community service per term.

"To Better The Man"To provide values-driven brotherhood experiences through life.We are a Fraternity founded upon the values of character. Our Values, once secret but made public in 2006, are what make us unique. Our Values call us to better ourselves through our actions and words. These are the values that we espouse:SILENCEHe has the strength to embrace silence and the will to build an interior life founded upon an honest desire to truly listen to others. Trust in silence transcends the gulf that is created when men feel the need to compete in action or rhetoric. He is introspective and self-reliant.CHARITYHe is charitable in the broadest sense of the word. A man who strives for a life of charity and service is more patient, kinder, and more forgiving of the flaws of others. A charitable man sacrifices of himself to help others and seeks no recognition in return. He is humble, reverent, and generous.PURITYHe consistently strives for purity of mind, body, and soul. The man who is pure of thought, word, and deed does not shrink from adversity or lofty goals. There is no self-pity, rationalizations, or apologies. He is moral and a gentleman in the finest sense of the word.HONORHe lives a life of personal integrity, thereby accruing honor. An honorable man lives up to promises made to others and to himself. A man of honor is not vain, and is willing to endure scorn or ostracism rather than conform to the pressures of peers, superiors, or the fashion of the day. He is ethical, honest, and trustworthy.PATRIOTISMHe loves his country, remaining consistently engaged in its affairs. He seeks to know his country and to pass that knowledge on to others. He is devoted to the principles of personal freedom, justice, and civic responsibility embedded in the U.S. Constitution that have made our country. He is loyal, proud, and humble.Thus our purpose is to Better the Man through the creation and perpetuation of brotherhood founded upon the values of character: Silence, Charity, Purity, Honor, and Patriotism.

Alpha Tau Delta, Fraternity for Professional Nurses, is a professional nursing organization, committed to providing an inter-fraternal spirit of cooperation by offering an opportunity for nurses to promote their personal and intellectual growth through education, networking, scholarships, guidance and a collective responsibility to the fraternity. Alpha Tau Delta seeks to achieve an environment that fosters excellence of individual performance, advancement of education, character enrichment and leadership.

The primary purpose of the Alpine Club is to foster a community of individuals who share a passion for mountaineering, climbing, and other alpine activities. This club serves as a platform for students to connect, go on outdoor adventures, grow as individuals, and share the stoke. We organize outdoor adventures, training programs, and social events that bring members together to explore the challenges and rewards of alpine pursuits.

Alzheimer's Buddies at UCI (ABUI) is a volunteer organization open to students interested in interacting with and forming relationships with individuals who have Alzheimer's disease living in memory care facilities. This organization is committed to leading the intergenerational movement responding to the social isolation and disengagement experienced by people in the intermediate to late stages of Alzheimer's Disease. Volunteers will have the opportunity to interact 1-on-1 with a buddy through activities and conversation.

club_name: Amateur Radio Association at UCI - ARA
description: The Amateur Radio Association @ UCI (ARA @ UCI) is a public service and hobby club created to serve current licensed and prospective amateur radio enthusiasts on and around campus. The purpose and objectives of ARA @ UCI are: To promote, educate and participate in traditional radio activities of Amateur radio. To provide a communications capability and technical knowledge for the community, especially in times of emergency. To promote social interaction and cooperation among our members and other enthusiasts in the community.

club_name: American Academy of Environmental Engineers and Scientists at UCI
description: The American Academy of Environmental Engineers and Scientists (AAEES) Student Chapter at the University of California, Irvine is a professional student organization dedicated to preparing its members for successful careers in environmental engineering and science. We aim to foster a collaborative environment for students interested in related fields through research opportunities, volunteer initiatives, career preparation and industry outreach, and peer connection.

club_name: AMERICAN CRIMINAL JUSTICE ASSOCIATION ALPHA SIGMA PHI CHAPTER at UCI

To provide a unified voice for professionals and students of criminal justice.6. To promote high standards of ethical conduct, professional training, and higher education within the criminal justice field.

club_name: American Fisheries Society Student Subunit at UCI
description: The mission of this student subunit is to inclusively educate and involve both graduate and undergraduate students in the economic, cultural, and ecological importance of local fisheries and to engage students in aquatic stewardship of local resources and professional development opportunities.

club_name: American Heart Association Healthy Hearts at UCI
description: Our mission is to advance health and hope for everyone by empowering students to engage in community outreach, research advocacy, fundraising, and wellbeing initiatives. Through education, service, and collaboration with healthcare professionals, we strive to promote cardiovascular health, inspire future leaders in medicine and science, and support the lifesaving mission of the American Heart Association.

The American Indian Student Association (A.I.S.A.) was founded in 1974. A.I.S.A.'s purpose is to support the academic and social education of American Indian Students at UC, Irvine and throughout the community. Initially providing a comfortable environment for Native American Students and Faculty in addition to promoting awareness to the campus community by sharing our cultural heritage. All UCI students are welcome.

club_name: American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics Student Branch at UCI (AIAA)
description: The AIAA Student Branch at UCI's mission is to help bridge the gap between UCI engineering students and the professional aerospace industry, regardless of major, socioeconomic status, or other factors. This may be done through involvement with other AIAA Student and Regional branches, hosting career, networking, informational, and community events, and supporting opportunities for student involvement through on-campus research and engineering design projects.

Our main goals are: - To promote the professional development of our members through programs and relations with other student chapters and organizations, and with the parent body, The American Institute of Chemical Engineers. - To contribute to the development of Chemical Engineering at University of California Irvine through activities involving faculty, industry professionals, and students.

club_name: American Lung Cancer Screening Initiative at UCI
description: The mission of the American Lung Cancer Screening Initiative is to promote lung cancer screening for people who are at high-risk of developing lung cancer. We work alongside a national network of physicians, students, and screening centers and promote lung cancer screening through outreach, service, education, policy advocacy, and research.

club_name: American Medical Student Association at UCI - Undergraduate Chapter - AMSA
description: The American Medical Student Association is committed to improving health care and healthcare delivery to all people; promoting active improvement in medical education; involving its members in the social, moral and ethical obligations of the profession of medicine; assisting in the improvement and understanding of world health problems; contributing to the welfare of medical students, interns, residents and post-MD/DO trainees; and advancing the profession of medicine and healthcare.

club_name: American Medical Women's Association Undergraduate Division at UCI
description: This organization was formed to help overcome the specific challenges faced by womenpursuing a career in medicine although membership is open to any pre-medical students. The group allows a safe, non-competitive forum for pre-health students to network and discuss issues such as professional school prerequisites, education, and family challenges.The mission statement of the American Medical Women's Association undergraduate Division is to empower, educate, and support pre-medical and pre-health students to advance within medicine.We will achieve this by promoting service projects that benefit the community, while instilling leadership and awareness, fostering valuable alliances with current medical students and practicing female physicians, encouraging and advocating for aspiring other undergraduate students, offering opportunities to gain insight about women's issues that help aid and commit them to improving women's health, and offering forums that provide the knowledge, insight, and perspective that will further aid women through their progression in the medical profession.

club_name: American Nuclear Society - Student Chapter at UCI (formerly American Nuclear Society)
description: The American Nuclear Society - Student Chapter at UCI is a student section of a national organization aimed at spreading information about nuclear science and technology.

club_name: American Pharmacists Association/California Pharmacists Association - Academy of Student Pharmacists at UCI
description: The mission of the APhA Academy of Student Pharmacists (APhA-ASP) is to be the collective voice of student pharmacists, to provide opportunities for professional growth, to improve patient care, and to envision and advance the future of pharmacy.

club_name: American Red Cross Club at UCI
description: Guided by the fundamental principles of the American Red Cross and its mission to prevent and alleviate human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors, the American Red Cross Club at UCI, will learn, practice, and exemplify humanitarian values through mission-related service projects.

ASCE at UCI is an organization that strives to create a welcoming environment in which all of the Civil & Environmental Engineers at UCI can gather to exchange ideas, form friendships, and develop professionally.

club_name: American Society of Mechanical Engineers at UCI
description: Our purpose is to provide a space for students interested in mechanicalengineering to discuss topics and apply practical knowledge in areas pertaining to engineering.ASME at UCI also serves to help mechanical engineering students develop professionalnetworks with established companies.
To empower and unite Filipino youth and students to fight for national democracy in the Philippines.

club_name: Anime Club at UCI (formerly Anime Community Club at UCI)
description: The purpose of the Anime Club at UCI shall be to provide its members and allies apositive and non-political environment to cultivate and pursue a shared interest in Japaneseanimation and its related mediums. This purpose shall be affirmed with respect to the normativeenvironment of social inclusiveness on-campus.

Founded to make the enjoyment of nature as accessible and fun as possible!! We do it all for our general members!! We have events like outdoor movie/karaoke, night hikes, camping, and more planned but always take suggestions!!

Anteater Artists is designed to unite artists of all levels to learn about the principles of animation. The goal of this club is to produce animated shorts and experience a production pipeline. All members will be encouraged to contribute story assets for the shorts. This is the club for artists interested in storyboarding, character design, visual development and layout, and animation. We aim to become a team that cooperates and progresses together in the arts. What we do in the club: - provide an environment to share our passion for art, provide constructive criticism, and learn from each other - strive to expand our skills as individuals and as part of a team - create portfolio-ready animation and art pieces Club goals: - develop fundamental skills of drawing (such as composition, sketching) - learn the principles of animation - produce a complete animated short and similar projects throughout the year.

club_name: Anteater Catholic (formerly University Catholic Community at UC Irvine)
description: To accompany and guide the Anteater Catholic community to a deep, dynamic, and personal encounter with Jesus Christ, seeking truth, beauty, and goodness as they belong, believe, and become who God created them to be.

club_name: Anteater Combat Engineering (formerly Anteater Combotics Engineering)
description: Anteater Combat Engineering (ACE) is an undergraduate combat robotics team, dedicated to designing and competing in competitive robotics from 1lb to 30lb weight classes. Comprised of passionate students from various engineering disciplines, ACE aims to push the boundaries of robotic engineering through hands-on experience, teamwork, and participation in competitions.

Anteater Emergency Medical Services' (AEMS) mission includes providing standby Basic Life Support (BLS) medical care and lifesaving education to the campus community, as well as providing a path for its members to become licensed and competent health care providers (EMT-B), gain clinical patient care experience, and learn more about how EMS and Emergency Medicine systems function, as it is connected with the Department of Emergency Medicine at the UCI Medical Center. AEMS provides standby BLS medical services at a variety of on-campus events through California EMT-certified volunteers from the student population. In addition, AEMS comprises student members who plan to become or are currently completing coursework to become an active EMT volunteer for the organization. AEMS has taught more than 1000 students, staff, and other community members how to control life-threatening bleeding through the nationally accredited Stop the Bleed campaign, which includes tourniquet application and wound packing. AEMS has joined more than 250 colleges nationwide with collegiate EMS organizations.

Anteater Fitness Initiative is a student-run organization that aims to promote fitness within UCI. It represents students who are willing to create an open environment where all individuals can learn about the basic requirements to achieve their fitness goals whether it be to learn how to exercise, gain a desired physique, or meet new gym partners. This organization aims to promote healthier physical bodies through fostering a supportive environment that is willing to assist and educate college students who are aiming to improve themselves.

The purpose of this organization is to promote physical fitness, confidence, discipline, and teamwork through the practice and instruction of gymnastics. Our mission is to provide a safe, inclusive, and inspiring environment where individuals of all skill levels can learn, grow, and excel in the sport of gymnastics.

The purpose of the Anteater History Club is to deepen the understanding and appreciation of history among the students of UCI. By providing educational enrichment through seminars, workshops, and guest lectures from distinguished scholars, the club aims to enhance the academic environment for students passionate about historical studies. It also promotes cultural awareness by organizing events that showcase diverse historical cultures and perspectives, thereby fostering a more inclusive and educated view of the global past.

club_name: Anteater Linux User Group at UCI
description: ALUG@UCI serves to bring Linux and open source enthusiasts together to talk about the latest Linux and open source developments, collaborate on open source projects, and provide a shared space for them.

This organization's mission is to align the past, present and future members of the US military in order to give current cadets the best understanding of the profession they will soon be joining, provide Veterans with a way to share their experience and knowledge in a way that will have a lasting impact on the future of the Armed Forces, and to create a connection with the Air Force Cadets on campus in a casual and student life oriented outlet.

Anteater Mock Trial is a student-run organization founded to teach students trial advocacy. Mock Trial gives undergraduate students an opportunity to learn firsthand about the work of trial attorneys, to understand the judicial system, to develop critical thinking, and enhance communication skills.

club_name: Anteater Moot Court (formerly Moot Court at UCI)
description: A method of teaching law and legal skills that requires students to analyze and argue both sides of a hypothetical legal issue using procedures modeled after those employed in state and federal appellate courts.

club_name: Anteater Music Production (formerly Anteater Student Audio Production)
description: AMP is an organization centered around and focused on music production that aims to teach awider audience about music production through a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW). It is open to allstudents of all levels of experience.
To create a fun and friendly environment for anyone to practice origami, regardless of skill level. Whether you are advanced or a beginner, everyone can find a place here.

The Anteater Photography Organization (APO) is a club for students with an interest in the photographic medium to come together to express their creativity and enrich their knowledge amongst a friendly community of their peers. APO offers students the opportunity to exhibit their interest in art, connect with other students, and create and share their work. APO provides learning experiences in the field of photography through topic-specific events that aim to engage and challenge students to become well-versed in the field. APO recognizes the unique abilities and skill levels of each individual student and encourages members to explore various aspects of photography, fostering an environment where members can challenge each other and grow together, ultimately becoming better at what they do.

ASR’s mission is to provide the UCI community with an alternative affordable entrance into motorsports. We strive to educate, unite, and integrate UCI affiliates into the Sim Racing Community while breaking away from the elitist nature of motorsports.

club_name: Anteater Smile Project at UCI - ASP
description: The Anteater Smile Project is a student-led group that aims to help make dental care more accessible for underserved (low-income) communities by carrying out volunteer projects and community service events, organizing fundraisers and donations campaigns to help fund free and low-cost dental clinics, and creating educational content about dental care and related topics.
Equip students to solve real Tech, Media, and Telecom problems through client projects, structured training, and data-driven insights.

TetrisUCI brings together students who share a passion for Tetris and other block-stacking games in the same genre. As one of the most iconic and enduring games of all time, Tetris is renowned for enhancing spatial reasoning, pattern recognition, and focus. Our mission is to create a welcoming community where Tetris players of all levels can connect, learn, and compete. Through regular biweekly meetings, members can enjoy casual play sessions, analyze strategies, and exchange tips with other players on campus. The club also aims to participate in the 2026 Collegiate TETR.IO League as well as future competitive events.

Anteater Trading empowers students to understand, analyze, and participate in financial markets through hands-on education and practical trading experience. We provide members with the tools, skills, and professional development needed to pursue careers in trading and finance. Our long-term vision is to cultivate a collaborative trading team that practices across multiple asset classes, including futures, options, and crypto.

AnteaterTV: Visual Media created for students, by students. Anteater TV is the only student-run visual media organization on the UCI campus. ATV strives to create fun and engaging entertainment, produce professional documentaries, cover events and share community knowledge at UCI through our production of written, photo, and video content.

The Anteater Undergraduate Law Journal is dedicated to promoting scholarly engagement among students interested in the study and discussion of legal issues. It aims to provide a respected platform for the publication of superior undergraduate research and commentary on significant legal and policy emphasizing the importance of legal scholarship.

Hello! We are the Anteaters Beach Club :) Join us to meet new people, explore the shore, watch sunsets, and play all sorts of beach games! Feel free to check out our discord where we make weekly club announcements, schedule hang-outs, and explore all the beaches around us: https://linktr.ee/anteaterbeachclub

Anteaters Engaged in Building strives to provide a space for systemic dialogue on social issues pertaining to students on campus. Through panels, workshops, and guest speakers members will be able to. The club purpose is to bring together community members, researchers, organizers, and stakeholders to support and promote innovative programming, research, and ideas aimed at examining social inequality, jettisoning false beliefs in the hierarchy of human value, and addressing structural barriers to belonging and thriving. This club advances a just and inclusive society through community-centered collaboration to stimulate transformative change. Students will have a space to be educated on issues directly related to them and discuss how they can contribute to change.

Anteaters for Animals (AFA) is a club dedicated to raising awareness about and advocating for the rights of non-human animals. The members of AFA strongly believe that animals are not ours to use for food, clothing, entertainment, experimentation, or any other non-consensual act that is forced upon non-human animals. Through campus community and outreach, volunteering at animal-centered facilities, and engaging the public with the vast ideas of veganism and animal liberation, our members try to be the change they wish to see in the world in regards to non-human animals. We also aim to provide our campus and community with the knowledge that they need to critically think about their food and lifestyle choices, so that they may be well-equipped to make the most ethical, environmentally conscious, and healthy choices for themselves and those around them.

Anteaters for Autism is an organization focused on acceptance, raising awareness, volunteering, and fundraising for individuals with autism. Throughout the academic year we engage in different activities, events, and discussions to fulfill our focus. Our organization hopes to educate our UCI community and Orange County, and do our part in improving the community climate for people with autism.

The mission of Anteaters for Suicide Prevention is to promote literacy and awareness about crisis management and provide resources available for students at UCI. We hope to empower students and build confidence in becoming a resource to others dealing with depression and suicidal thoughts. A goal of Anteaters for Suicide Prevention is to provide opportunities for students to gain certifications and training to better assist peers and others in need. We will serve as a peer support group for those volunteering for crisis lines or other suicide prevention movements. Through this, we hope to foster a community of students who are eager to get involved, prepared to help those in need, and equipped with resources for themselves and others.

This organization was formed to express members' interest in baking, develop baking skills and utilize organization members' talents to make various baked goods for underserved youth in our community. This group is meant to give every and all UCI students interested in baking an outlet to meet with like-minded people and learn from each other on how to be better bakers, while simultaneously serving the community.Over the course of the school year we will complete a number of community service projects, primarily through the network of For Goodness Cakes, a non-profit organization where volunteers bake various desserts to celebrate special occasions for youth living in foster care, homeless shelters, and other alternative living agencies. It is through these projects, as well as meetings and other club functions, that members will serve their community, improve their baking skills, and foster a network of peers similar to them.

Anteaters Tzu Ching is a collegiate chapter of the Tzu Chi Foundation. Tzu Ching directly translates to "Compassionate Youths" committed to actively participating in community service. While Tzu Chi Foundation is based upon Buddhist philosophies, people of all religions, gender, and races are equally respected. To follow the missions of promoting medicine, education, charity, and humanities, Anteaters Tzu Ching actively participate in medical outreaches, food banks, and tutoring programs in an effort to aid those in need and to help them escape the ongoing cycle of poverty. In addition to service, Anteaters Tzu Ching aims to promote vegetarianism and environmentalism.

Our mission is to bring people together to build homes, communities, and hope. As a campus chapter of Habitat for Humanity® of Orange County, we strive to make a world where everyone has a decent place to live, and somewhere they can call home, with the help of passionate volunteers.

Welcome UCI students, staff, faculty, and especially the Class of 2022 to our award winning yearbook page! The 2020 UCI Anthology Yearbook was officially inducted into the Walsworth Gallery of Excellence. It is a prestigious honor to reach the top echelon as one of the most distinguished yearbooks in the country. Join us in celebrating this huge accomplishment as we commend our team's outstanding work and commitment to excellence.

The Anthropology Club at UCI aims to foster a vibrant community of students passionate aboutexploring human cultures, societies, and histories. We are dedicated to creating a collaborativeand inclusive environment where members can engage in meaningful discussions, participate inopportunities, and gain insights into the diverse world of anthropology. Through workshops,guest lectures, cultural events, and hands-on experiences, we strive to connect academicknowledge with real-world applications while celebrating the richness of human diversity.

club_name: Anthropology Graduate Group for Research and Organization - AGGRO
description: The mission of the Anthropology Graduate Group for Research and Organization (AGGRO) is to foster a sense of belonging and community among the anthropology graduate student body. With regular social and academic events, AGGRO aims to provide a platform for anthropology graduate students to connect, collaborate, and advance in both their academic, professional, and personal pursuits. With writing groups, research partnerships, student led conferences, workshops, social gatherings, and more, AGGRO seeks to support anthropology graduate students and create a safe space for academic innovation and interdisciplinary thought. These spaces aspire to be a key resource in shaping future scholars by fostering a supportive and inclusive academic environment that will advance the next generation of anthropological knowledge.

Applied Investment Research Group (AIRG) aims to provide business-oriented UCI students with an accessible platform for investment strategy and portfolio management learning and quantitative research opportunities. In doing so, AIRG prepares students with relevant experiences for a career in the field of financial services, including asset/wealth management, hedge fund, investment banking, consulting, etc. The primary activities includes: 1. Conducting quantitative financial research on various types of investment vehicles, including stocks, bonds, options, etc. 2. Constructing & managing a research-based investment portfolio in a simulated trading environment. 3. Developing algorithmic trading strategies and backtesting.

The Arabic Language and Culture Club (ALCC) is dedicated to fostering a deep appreciation and understanding of the Arabic language, its diverse cultures, and rich history.The ALCC also hopes to provide its members with a background in Arabic with opportunities to use and improve their Arabic language skills.

Archery Club at UCI is a recreational and competitive club sport that competes in barebow, bowhunter, compound, and recurve divisions. The club competes on both regional and national levels and has never failed to put at least one athlete on the podium in every competition since its establishment in 2006. All prospective teammates, experienced or not, are more than welcome to join every Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday in the Back Court Gym of the Anteater Recreation Center (ARC). All practices are $5 each until the $55 cap per quarter. All interested students and faculty are encouraged to give archery a shot! For questions, feel free to email archery@uci.edu!

club_name: Armenian Pre-Health Society at UC Irvine
description: This organization is dedicated toward educating Armenian Undergraduate Students regarding different healthcare occupations by hosting guest speakers (doctors, medical students, health administrators, etc.) and providing valuable tools and resources to guide students through the processes of graduate school admissions, standardized tests, and getting involved in research.

club_name: Armenian Pre-Law Students Association at UCI
description: The Armenian Pre-Law Students Association is a multicultural organization that aims to create a supportive and inclusive community for students interested in pursuing a legal career. The purpose of such a club is to provide a space where individuals from diverse backgrounds can come together to explore and discuss legal issues, share experiences, and gain insights into the field of law. Moreover, The Armenian Pre-Law Students Association shall raise efforts to bring about awareness about legal structures and the law of the country Armenia and the Armenian Community in the Irvine area, while promoting positive social interactions with experienced Armenian lawyers and lawmakers. Overall, the goal of a multicultural Armenian Pre-law organization is to foster an inclusive environment that prepares its members for success in their legal pursuits while celebrating and embracing diversity within the legal community.

The Armenian Students Association at UC Irvine is a student organization dedicated to preserving and promoting Armenian culture, heritage, and community on campus. We aim to foster a strong sense of identity and unity among Armenian students through cultural, educational, and social programming. ASA also works to raise awareness about Armenian issues within the broader UCI community and build connections with the local Armenian population. Through our events and initiatives, we create a welcoming space for students to engage, learn, and grow together.

club_name: Art Club Collective (formerly AntARTers ART Club)
description: We're a 💖SOCIAL ORG👁️ for Women🚺 & the LGBTQ+🏳️‍🌈 community that's art-oriented!We accomplish this through families, bigs and littles, weekly socials, and more! ­You do NOT have to create art or be an artist to have a valued place here!­ Just a love for art-oriented things, an eye for aesthetics, and a desire to be around other people who share those interests. The crux of our org is creating a space and opportunities for deep social connections with art-oriented people. Nowhere else on campus will you find such a large group of people who get excited going to art walks, enjoying concerts, having wine and paint nights, photoshoots, hiking/seeing nature, plants, carving pumpkins, costume parties, and more. We've founded a place for those people to mingle and build strong friendships.Visit our Instagram(@artclubuci)(www.instagram.com/artclubuci/) to find an email signup form to get added to the intro

The mission of the Art History Undergraduate Association is to encourage undergraduates in shared interest and passion for art by connecting them to a network of faculty, alumni, and students. We seek to create art-filled environments that are both engaging and relevant. A main objective for this year is to organize events throughout the academic year that will grant opportunities for students to interact with art on a more intimate level, through museum trips, games, and our annual art show. Our doors are open to anyone with even a passing interest in art, and we hope to inspire a lifelong love of art in all those we encounter by making it more accessible to the UCI community in fun, interactive ways.

AI@UCI aims to build a community where all UC Irvine undergraduate and graduate students with a curiosity for artificial intelligence can cultivate their understanding of a rapidly evolving field of computer science. From application-based, beginner-friendly workshops to long-term, member-driven projects, there's a way for students of all experience levels to get involved first-hand in the dynamic world of AI.

The mission of Artistic Swimming Club at UCI is to promote the sport of artistic swimming at UC Irvine by forming a club of athletes who will participate in the sport at both the recreational and competitive levels, design artistic swimming routines that can be performed at water shows and competitions, and participate in the USA Artistic Swimming (USAAS) collegiate competitive program.

Our Mission is to develop, support, and empower Pan-Asians throughout their careers with a network for growth and advancement that enables our members to serve our vibrant communities to the best of their abilities.

club_name: Asian American Christian Fellowship at UCI - AACF
description: The mission of Asian American Christian Fellowship (AACF) is to reach into the university and collegiate community, primarily to those who are Asian Pacific Americans, with the life-changing message of Jesus Christ.

club_name: Asian American Journalists Association at UCI
description: The mission of AAJAUCI is to foster a dynamic and inclusive community for individuals interested in journalism, media, and communication. Our overarching purpose is to empower and support Asian American journalists and media professionals, while also promoting diversity and inclusion within the broader field of journalism. The organization shall be broad in its scope, allowing flexibility to adapt to the evolving landscape of media and journalism, with the primary goal of providing a platform for education, collaboration, and networking.

club_name: Asian Pacific American Law Student Association (APALSA)
description: Asian Pacific American Law Student Association (APALSA) at UCI Law is a political, community service, academic, and social organization dedicated to serving the Asian and Pacific Islander American (APIA) communities at the UCI School of Law, in Southern California, and in the greater community at large. We define the communities as broadly encompassing, but not limited to, East Asians, Pacific Islanders, South Asians, and Southeast Asians, and including immigrants and U.S.-born individuals. The mission of APALSA is to promote awareness, discourse, and activism on key social justice issues facing Asian and Pacific Islander Americans, as well as other historically underrepresented groups. APALSA aims to recognize and celebrate diversity by disaggregating the APIA identity in an effort to foster cross-cultural understanding, inclusivity, and unity within the APIA community. APALSA is committed to activities that increase the access to justice and legal services of APIA communities as a way to effect practical change. In remembering the cross-racial solidarity movement at various UC campuses in the 1960s, APALSA seeks to accomplish this mission by working collaboratively with other like-minded organizations at UCI, in Orange County, and around the country. APALSA provides a community-driven network for APIA students at UCI Law and is open to all UCI Law Students.

The ASL Club at the University of California, Irvine is dedicated to fostering an inclusive community where students of all backgrounds can learn, practice, and celebrate American Sign Language (ASL) and Deaf culture. Through education, cultural engagement, and collaboration with the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (D/HH) community, we strive to promote accessibility, allyship, and linguistic humility on campus and beyond.

club_name: Association for Computing Machinery at UC Irvine - ACM
description: Members of ACM @ UCI enjoy computer science and puzzles. We study algorithms and compete in international and prestigious programming contests like "ACM ICPC", "IEEExtreme", and "Google Codejam". The overall mission of our club is to maximize of our understanding of computer science topics and problem solving and learning skills that one would not generally learn in a classroom setting. In recent years, we've consistently fielded one of the top 3 teams in ICPC Southern California. We are also branching out into programming competition related to machine learning and data science.

club_name: Association for Computing Machinery Special Interest Group in Graphics at UCI
description: To promote, teach, and foster a community around computer graphics and vision.

club_name: Association of Latino Professionals for America
description: To empower and develop Latino students as leaders of character for the nation in every sector of the global economy.

club_name: Association of Muslims In Politics and Law
description: We strive to help young American Muslims achieve their future professional goals within politics and law.

club_name: Association of Women in Mathematics at UC Irvine
description: The purpose of AWM at UCI is to create a community in which every UCI student can thrive in their mathematical endeavors, and to promote equitable opportunity and treatment of women and others of marginalized genders and gender identities across the mathematical sciences.

The Astronomy Club at UCI is an organization open to all majors on campus. We strive to create a humble and friendly environment for those who are interested in the wonders of the cosmos and the beautiful science of Astronomy and Astrophysics. Astronomy Club is a new and ever-evolving club on campus with access to multiple high-end telescopes available for members to view through. Astronomy related events like Astro Trivia and Rocket Launching take place throughout the year. Trips to observatories and campgrounds like Polamor Observatory and Griffith Observatory also take place. For those interested in advancing their knowledge about Astronomy and Astrophysics, Astronomy Club at UCI hosts guest speakers who are currently doing research in the Astro field here at UCI such as graduates and professors. We also like to teach our members about the constellations, stars, and other night sky objects!

We are a student-run, competitive undergraduate organization dedicated to promoting cultural awareness through the different and diverse forms of classical Indian dance. We host weekly practice sessions where students have the chance to collaborate with their fellow UCI peers who have similar backgrounds.

We seek to advance the gospel of Jesus Christ at UCI. As Paul the Apostle writes, "How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone preaching? And how are they to preach unless they are sent? As it is written, 'How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the good news!' But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, 'Lord, who has believed what he has heard from us?' So faith comes from hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ."

The mission of the AWS Cloud Club at UC Irvine is to help students learn cloud computing in a simple, hands-on, and supportive way. The club creates a welcoming space where students can explore AWS tools, practice real-world skills, and learn by building projects together. Through workshops, guided labs, group projects, and guest talks, the club connects classroom learning with practical experience. Our goal is to help students gain confidence, develop technical skills, and prepare for careers in cloud, software, data, and other technology fields—regardless of their prior experience.

B-Boys Anonymous was founded in 1999 by Mark Kamimoto as an open practice environment for freestyle dancers on campus. Originally known as the Breakdance Club at UC Irvine, BBA allows students with common interests in dance to express themselves through music and movement. The club's focus is to promote the love and knowledge of all forms of freestyle dance. Today, BBA currently serves as UC Irvine's premiere freestyle dance club that is also heavily involved in the Irvine Dance Community (IDC) with the annual hosting of events such as All IDC and the Spring Quarter Dance Festival, as well as quarterly battles. Through all of the development and growth that BBA has experienced since its founding, the club's initial focus remains. At BBA sessions, we strive to teach the foundation of freestyle dance and the history of Hip Hop culture to students willing to learn and be apart of its developing scene in the UC Irvine community.

Our purpose is to create an environment in which badminton players can meet, play (recreational or competitive), and socialize. We also wish to expose badminton to a wider population and create a competitive environment for players who wish to improve and challenge themselves. We compete in the Southern California Collegiate Badminton League and in the USA Badminton Collegiate Nationals, along with many travel tournaments. Our players range from a wide variety of skill level and backgrounds. We aim to create a community of badminton players that will stick together and challenge each other to improve.

The mission of the Baha'i Club at UCI is to foster unity, promote spiritual growth, and cultivate a spirit of service among students of all backgrounds. We aim to create an inclusive environment that encourages independent investigation of truth, promotes interfaith dialogue, and supports the application of Baha'i principles to address contemporary challenges. Through educational programs, social activities, and community service initiatives, we strive to contribute positively to campus life and the wider community, while nurturing the intellectual and spiritual development of our members.

Ballet Folklorico de UC Irvine is a student run organization that welcomes students, alumni, and community members to participate and learn about a variety of different Mexican histories and traditions through dance and music. As a multicultural organization, we strive to promote and educate others on Mexican histories and cultures, while also engaging and interacting with the diversity surrounding us on the UC Irvine campus and the community. BFDUCI aims to create an inclusive and non judgemental community for all students of any race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, color, disability, national origin, age, or marital status. We plan to cultivate an environment so that members feel comfortable with freely expressing who they are, whether it be through dance & music or other creative means.

The Ballroom Dance Club at UCI was established to create a welcoming space where students can begin or continue their journey in ballroom dancing. Regardless of skill level, age, or background, BDC at UCI transcends the typical definitions of a dance team and strives to achieve long-term goals of fostering friendship and understanding by building a community through expression—exploring communication beyond the limits of language. In collaboration with ballroom dance teams from other UC campuses (e.g., UCLA, UCSD) and private colleges, BDC at UCI pursues short-term goals of participating in and hosting collegiate ballroom dance competitions, performances, and showcases. Through these events, BDC at UCI also aims to give back to the Orange County community by raising funds to support various charities and organizations that are meaningful to its members. BDC at UCI welcomes all UCI undergraduate students and maintains a zero-tolerance policy for any form of discriminatory behavior.

The Bangladeshi Student Association (BSA) fosters unity among Bangladeshi students while promoting our culture within our diverse community. We create a welcoming platform, connecting students through cultural activities for personal growth. Our short-term goals include organizing festivals and cultural performances and preserving and sharing our heritage with others. In the long term, we hope to collaborate with other associations and institutions, promoting cross-cultural understanding and appreciation for Bangladesh's vibrant heritage, along with potential fundraising for humanitarian causes in Bangladesh. Our club welcomes any individuals who have an interest in the rich culture and traditions of Bangladesh. We welcome everyone, regardless of their background or ethnicity, eager to learn, share, and promote cultural diversity.

Bare Bones Dance Theater is a student-run, on campus organization that encourages and supports an artistic meeting of the minds. Through the production of an annual dance concert, the undergraduate dancers, choreographers, production team, and the larger community collaborate to produce a professional theatrical experience. In addition, the organization seeks to extend its artistic endeavors beyond the University of California, Irvine by hosting outreach performances and workshops for local high school students. Lastly, BBDT hosts professional artists from the greater Los Angeles area to teach dance workshops for reduced rates, providing students the opportunity to be exposed to the performing arts. BBDT welcomes undergraduates of all majors from UCI to participate and share their creative abilities to enrich UCI and the Orange County Community.
Our purpose is to raise people who wholeheartedly love Jesus and release God's restoration and Kingdom revival into their spheres of influence.

Our group aims to grow the beach volleyball community. We organize community recreational, competitive, and travel play for both men's, women's, and co-ed beach volleyball. Please follow our Instagram @bcvb_uci for runs.

ABA shall exist to build a tight-knit community of Christian undergraduate business students and professionals committed to living out Gospel-centered fellowship. Through experiential activities, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we seek to integrate faith with business excellence.

We are a Bible-centered and gospel-centered organization that seeks to glorify Christ through fellowship, accountability, and outreach at the UCI campus. Our functions include weekly college Bible studies, campus evangelism, and English Corners to outreach to International students.

The mission of Best Buddies at UCI is to establish a global volunteer movement that creates opportunities for one-to-one friendships, integrated employment, leadership development, and inclusive living for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). We do this by matching student volunteers in mutually enriching friendships with persons with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

Beta Alpha Psi is an honorary organization for financial information students and professionals. The primary objective of Beta Alpha Psi is to develop and foster a passion for learning in the field of business information. This includes promoting the study and practice of accounting, finance and information systems; providing opportunities for self-development, service and association among members and practicing professionals, and encouraging a sense of ethical, social, and public responsibility. The Beta Alpha Psi Nu PI Chapter was established as an official chapter at UCI in 2016. Nationally, as of 2016, there are 314 chapters on college and university campuses with over 300,000 members initiated since Beta Alpha Psi's formation.

club_name: Beta Beta Beta (Tri Beta) - Biology Honor Society
description: Beta Beta Beta (Tri Beta) is a national honor society that is dedicated to supporting undergraduates who are interested in the biological sciences and research. Membership includes the opportunity to apply for research grants, to attend district and national conventions, and more! The chapter at UCI will prioritize opportunities for students to grow as student-researchers and future leaders.
Our mission is to be a Christ-centered community that expands the kingdom of God.

Better Humans at UCI is a non-educational, student-led organization dedicated to combating the growing loneliness epidemic through authentic human connection and regular social interaction. Our short-term goal is to create safe, inclusive spaces where students can gather, meet new people, and engage in meaningful activities. Our long-term goal is to foster a healthier, more connected student body by promoting consistent interpersonal engagement as a pathway to improved mental health.

Beyond the Verdict is dedicated to advancing the understanding of the criminal justice system, with a particular emphasis on wrongful convictions and exonerations. Through our podcast and academic sessions, we illuminate the personal stories behind wrongful convictions and explore the complexities of the justice system. Our mission is to make these critical issues both accessible and compelling, bridging the gap between academic learning and real-world experience. By featuring insightful discussions with law enforcement professionals, legal experts, and advocates, we aim to foster a deeper, more nuanced understanding of the justice system, inspire empathy, and encourage positive change.

club_name: Bhagat Puran Singh Health Initiative at UCI
description: To provide basic health care screening and general health/nutrition advice to underserved and neglected communitiesTo fight heart disease and diabetes among the at-risk populations and promote general health knowledge to prevent chronic disease.To Promote Youth Advancement among underserved populations.To Promote Outreach among our members and in the community.

club_name: Bilingual Teacher Student Association at UCI - BTSA
description: This organization is open to ALL student and will focus on developing and supporting future educators with the mission to promote the importance of Bilingual Education. As well as thosewho are interested in learning more about Bilingual education and connecting with other future teachers. With the help of our Four Pillars: ACADEMICS, MENTORSHIP, SOCIALS& VOLUNTEERING. We hope to help ALL students. At Bilingual Teacher Student Association, we believe bilingual education is the future of education in the United States. With more and more dual immersion schools opening up around the state of California, BTSA wants to be a source of information for students who want to know more about bilingual education.

To unify and serve undergraduates through the student-led promotion of academic resources,student advocacy and philanthropy in the larger community, as part of a greater effort to foster a campus space for intellectual discussion as well as personal and professional excellence, especially within the Biological Sciences community.

Biomedical Engineering Society (BMES) at UCI is an organization that encourages exploration into the field of biomedical engineering. Our mission is to foster an inclusive community for students interested in biomedical engineering through mentorship, career building, hands-on project experience, and outreach. By building a network of undergraduate and graduate students, professors, and industry professionals, we aim to strengthen the biomedical engineering community in and around UCI.

The Biomolecular Design and Modeling Club is dedicated to exploring and promoting the advancement of students in computational biochemistry, machine learning–driven biomolecular design, and synthetic biology.​

We connect students with the people, knowledge, and experiences that bring biotechnology to life. Through engaging events, practical opportunities, and a welcoming community, we help members learn, collaborate, and take meaningful steps toward their future in science.

Birding at UCI is an Audubon Campus Chapter founded in 2023 that aims to foster an inclusive community of UCI students and faculty interested in birdwatching and the outdoors. We have partnered with various local and UCI-affiliated ecological organizations, including UCI Nature and Sea and Sage Audubon, to provide unique volunteering and educational experiences for our members.Email us at birding@uci.edu or refer to this linktree for more information: linktr.ee/birdingatuci
Centered on faith and justice, we guide students into lives of purpose, service, and leadership. We build community, teach Scripture, and inspire Christ-centered impact.

Our mission is to provide a community that empowers Black artists, while also advocating for the equality and rights of all Black creatives. Black Door produces and showcases all that encompasses the Black narrative. Black Door aims to allow a safe space that supports individuals in articulating the intricacies and delicacies of one's Blackness. Black Door is a space that welcomes all performers, managers, visual artists, and theatre practitioners that identify within the African diaspora. We welcome the support and engagement of the entire UCI Arts, and UCI community!"

The group, formed in the mid 2000's, was established in response to the need for support among Black graduate and professional students across the UC Irvine campus, who found themselves facing challenges relating to their ability to navigate the Irvine environment. The BGSN was designed to provide a sense of purpose for Black students here at UC Irvine. The goal was to create a space that would be resonant, supportive, nurturing and productive for Black graduate and professional students. As an organization looking out for the best interest of its membership, it strives to provide a sense of community and camaraderie.

The Black Graduation Celebration ceremony at UC Irvine celebrates the achievement of our graduating undergraduate and graduate students in the traditions and customs that have been a foundation for the African American community. The ceremony not only symbolizes the bond of our community but also celebrates the unstoppable success of our future leaders with their families, mentors, and peers.

Black in Tech (BIT) empowers Black students at UC Irvine to excel in technology by fostering community, providing resources, and promoting representation. We are committed to creating a supportive environment where Black students can connect, learn, and grow together, ultimately shaping the future of tech.

Our purpose is to provide Black students with the knowledge necessary to make crucial decisions as they seek admission to law school, to deepen their understanding of their desired profession, and foster lifelong relationships.

club_name: Black Law Student Association at UCI
description: The purpose of BLSA is to utilize the collective resources of the member chapters to: - articulate and promote the educational, professional, political, and social needs and goals of Black law students; - foster and encourage professional competence; - improve the relationship between Black law students, Black attorneys, and the American legal structure; - instill in the Black attorney and law student a greater awareness and commitment to the needs of the Black community; - influence the legal community by bringing about meaningful legal and political change that addresses the needs and concerns of the Black community; - adopt and implement policies of economic independence; - encourage Black law students to pursue careers in the judiciary; and - do all things necessary and appropriate to accomplish these purposes.

club_name: Black Organization for Leadership and Development
description: We provide Black students with safe spaces to celebrate their identity while cultivating essential skills in order to be the leaders of tomorrow. We seek to create spaces that encourage members to lead in bold and unconventional ways in comparison to societal norms.

The Black Psychology Student Association of UC Irvine seeks to provide a support network which focuses on preparing Black students at the University of California, Irvine (UC Irvine) to become successful and influential members of the psychological community; Along with creating an inclusive and non judgmental community for all students to learn and gain valuable opportunities to prepare them for graduate and professional schooling.

It is the mission of the Black Student Union to create and promote a supportive and inclusive community, while also intellectually challenging the Black students on the campus of UC Irvine. This organization, established specifically for political reasons, works for a more humane and culturally relevant college experience for the students on this campus. The Black Student Union strives to provide educational, cultural and social programs which we hope will inspire our community to take action, through activism as well as outreach on and off of our home campus. This organization serves as the umbrella for the other Black organizations on campus, with our ultimate goal being to provide a welcoming and united space for our community while also stimulating an awareness of political, economical, and social forces affecting the African Diaspora.

The purpose of the club is to introduce the art of blacksmithing to students with an emphasis on materials science. Understanding the how to make materials from forging metal is more than experimentation and also heavily focused on the science behind it. Every hit the metal endures, shapes it to a respectable strength and durability which can enhance the features of the product the student creates.

Blockchain at UCI's main aim is to spread blockchain technology to UCI, Orange County, and the surrounding LA Regions. We want to promote the decentralized way of distributing data among a large audience and show how blockchain can be used in a variety of fields. We want to bridge this gap between the industry and student population through opportunities for our members such as workshops, educational seminars, hackathons, conferences, and networking events so everyone benefits from blockchain. Finally, Blockchain at UCI aims to be the central hub for all blockchain in Orange County and surrounding LA regions.

The Book Club at UCI aims to facilitate meaningful connections through our shared love for books. We hope to hold quarterly book readings, discussions, and events (social, community service, etc) that will enrich our lives as students. Reading holds different values in different lives– hobby, passion, career, creative relief, therapy– and this club seeks to create a safe space for each.

Our mission is to provide reading materials to readers in prisons across the United States. We hope that each book we send out reaches someone who aspires to improve their well-being and contribute to others around them with emotional, social, and professional knowledge.

Eager to level up your Bowling skills? Have a desire to knock down some pins as a hobby? Need an excuse to take a break from academics and hang out with friends? Join us for some games at Bowling at UCI! Whether you rarely bowl or are a professional bowler with multiple 300-point games, we hope to create the space for your to not only develop your skills but also play with other bowlers at UCI. Follow us at @bowlingatuci on Instagram to learn more. Happy bowling!

Boxing Club at UCI is affiliated with UCI Club Sports and we compete in the National Collegiate Boxing Association. Our club seeks to provide the UCI community with an engaging and applicable way to stay in shape while forming connections with others. Whether you're an experienced boxer or a beginner looking to stay fit, boxing club will challenge you and give you the opportunity to create bonds.
We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that uses simple math, writing and reading-aloud exercises as an intervention to improve cognitive function in those with Alzheimer's Disease.

club_name: Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Club at UCI
description: Purpose/Mission Statement * The purpose of the Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Club is to provide an easy-going social environment that gives undergraduate students an introduction to the techniques of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. * No experience is necessary to become a part of this organization, but as a member of the organization you will receive professional hands-on experience. * This organization is driven by the passion and motivation of its members. The more work and effort you put into the hands-on experience, the more you will get out of it. Events * Brazilian Jiu Jitsu will hold annual collegiate tournaments with local schools. * Organized training sessions with other club members. * Seminars with guest instructors. * Social gatherings such as attending tournaments, beach parties and bbq's. Goals * To create a collegiate component to Brazilian Jiu Jitsu in order to provide students with a safe and affordable way to compete.

Brick Theatre Company aims to support and uplift the intersectional voices of the LGBTQ+ community through theatre. We strive to facilitate the creation of new works that truthfully represent the diverse voices in our community. We will maintain an open dialogue with our audiences so that we can educate and build connections that will uplift all of us. We strive to ignite passion and compassion in ourselves and our audiences. We strive to become a welcoming home and expression of love and pride for all LGBTQ+ students on campus.

Bridges International at UCI is a club dedicated to serving international students at UCI. We are a group started by Christians to help International students to adjust and feel at home in Irvine. Our motto is providing a "Home Away from Home", through weekly English conversation program, Friday night dinners, fun events, and other spiritual resources.
